statement.text:
A group G is called n-Engel if it satisfies the identity [x, y, . . . , y] = 1, where
y is taken n times. Are there non-nilpotent finitely generated n-Engel groups?
Comment of 2017: For n = 2, 3, 4, finitely generated n-Engel groups are nilpotent.
A course of lectures devoted to constructing non-nilpotent finitely generated n-Engel
groups for sufficiently large n is given by E. Rips and is available on the Internet.
                                                                               B. I. Plotkin
